QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_19

question.text: Indian AIFs are increasingly adopting international LP-reporting templates. Which of the following pair correctly maps an industry body to its reporting standard?

answer.text: CFA Institute — GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards)
IPEV — Stewardship Code for listed investments
ILPA — leverage reporting format prescribed by SEBI

explanation.text: **The Logic:** GIPS is published by the CFA Institute and governs performance reporting standards. IPEV issues VALUATION guidelines; ILPA issues Capital Call, Distribution and Quarterly Reporting templates for LPs; EVCA is the European VC/PE standards body. Only option A maps correctly. **The Trap:** Stewardship Code is SEBI's, not IPEV's. SEBI (not ILPA) prescribes leverage reporting. Form 64C is an Indian IT Rules form, not EVCA. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B (PM) tests GIPS on listed portfolios. XIX-C reframes for private-fund vintage reporting — DPI, RVPI, TVPI metrics that GIPS accommodates. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Even though SEBI does not yet mandate GIPS, adopting ILPA quarterly templates wins credit with foreign LPs in fund-of-funds and sovereign channels. The incremental cost is mostly a one-time template build.
